description: This file contains debugging utilities for libcurl, including a dump function to output data in hex or ASCII and a trace callback for logging curl activity. It is conditionally compiled when CURL_DEBUG is defined.

methods.name: void dump(const char * text,FILE * stream,unsigned char * ptr,size_t size,char nohex)
methods.description: Outputs the provided data buffer to a stream, either in hexadecimal or ASCII format, with configurable width and handling for line breaks.

methods.name: int my_trace(CURL * handle,curl_infotype type,char * data,size_t size,void * userp)
methods.description: A libcurl callback function for tracing and logging curl operations, outputting information based on the curl_infotype loaded from the provided user data.

ctags.name: dump
ctags.signature: (const char * text,FILE * stream,unsigned char * ptr,size_t size,char nohex)
